data.name: Shreya
data.gender_notes: Shreya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śreyas, 'better, superior, fortunate', from the root śrī, 'prosperity'. Its root is Sanskrit śrī (श्री). A classical Sanskrit term for excellence. Shreya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Fortunate; excellent; superior”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shreya expresses “Fortunate; excellent; superior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śreyas, 'better, superior, fortunate', from the root śrī, 'prosperity'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shreya total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

vedic_reference.note: The name Shreya is derived from the Sanskrit word श्रेय: shreya, which means prosperity, wealth, good fortune, or happiness.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for excellence.

faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Shreya is 4 (ruling planet Rahu). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Saturday is the traditional association for Shreya. This is interpretive.

faq.a: In English, Shreya is rendered as “Fortunate; excellent; superior”.
